source.title: Relative pseudomonads, Kleisli bicategories, and substitution monoidal structures

trace.notes: Normalized the zbMATH URL as a bibliographic resolver. Metadata identified DOI 10.1007/s00029-017-0361-3 and arXiv 1612.03678 for the exact work. The readable exact-work artifact used for extraction was the open-access Springer PDF with matching title and DOI.

Mapped the PDF as a 40-page research article. Structure: Abstract; 1 Introduction; 2 Background; 3 Relative pseudomonads; 4 Kleisli bicategories; 5 Lax idempotent relative pseudomonads; 6 Liftings of relative pseudomonads; 7 Substitution monoidal structures; Acknowledgements; References. Key definitions/results include relative pseudomonad, Kleisli bicategory, lax idempotent relative pseudomonad, liftings to strict or pseudoalgebras, extension of a 2-monad to a pseudomonad on a Kleisli bicategory, and applications to substitution monoidal structures.

Scanned the introduction for explicit or implicit open-problem language. The phrase 'the question of when a 2-monad on the 2-category Cat of small categories can be extended to a pseudomonad on the bicategory Prof of profunctors' is a motivating question that the paper states it answers directly via Theorem 6.3, so it was not extracted as an open or unsolved research problem.

Scanned Sections 2 through 7 for markers such as Question, Problem, Open, unknown whether, conjecture, future work, and remaining questions. No explicit open-problem block, problem list, conjecture, unresolved question, or solved-problem label was found.
No candidate questions were extracted, so there were no duplicate clusters to merge.
No accepted items were produced. The source adequacy gate passed for the source artifact, and no candidate met the extraction criteria for an evidence-backed open or unsolved research question.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/1652913.json and outputs/latest.json.
